blocks.html:
Settlers Country Manor Wedding Photographer

If you're planning a wedding at Settlers Country Manor, you're choosing one of Auckland's most awarded and best-loved wedding venues. As a preferred photographer at Settlers, I know this property intimately — its light, its layout, and the small details that help every wedding day here run beautifully.

Set on seven acres of manicured gardens in Waimauku, Settlers Country Manor pairs more than a century of heritage character with the polish and comfort today's couples expect. With lakeside settings, palm-lined pathways, arched bridges, and towering century-old trees, it's a venue built for both elegant ceremonies and unforgettable photography.

A Venue Designed for Weddings

What makes Settlers Country Manor so special is how completely it has been built around the wedding day.

Ceremony, photos, reception, and dancing all happen within the same private estate, so there's no travel and no lost time between moments. Couples can marry beside the lake, walk beneath the pines for portraits, dine under crystal chandeliers in the Banquet Hall, and finish the night on the dance floor — all without leaving the grounds.

As a preferred vendor at Settlers, I've had the chance to photograph this venue across different seasons and light conditions, which means I already know where the best moments will unfold before the day even begins.

A Stunning Setting for Wedding Photography

From a photography perspective, Settlers Country Manor offers remarkable variety in a single location:

  • Lakeside views and romantic arched bridges for timeless portraits

  • Century-old pines and manicured lawns for soft, natural backdrops

  • Heritage-style interiors with soaring ceilings and crystal chandeliers

  • Palm-lined pathways and tropical garden touches for depth and texture

  • Elegant evening reception lighting for atmospheric, romantic images

  • Muriwai Beach just minutes away, offering a striking black-sand contrast for couples who want a second location

With this much variety on and around the property, it's possible to create a rich, varied gallery without ever needing to leave Waimauku.

A Venue That Handles Everything Seamlessly

One of the biggest advantages of Settlers Country Manor is how smoothly the entire day flows.

With decades of experience hosting weddings, the team manages catering, coordination, décor, and on-the-day logistics, which means couples can stay present and guests can simply relax. The estate is also well suited to larger and multicultural celebrations, with spaces designed to accommodate extended timelines, cultural rituals, and outfit changes without feeling rushed.

For photography, this seamlessness is a real gift. When a venue runs smoothly, there's more time to slow down, notice the quiet moments, and capture the day as it genuinely unfolds.

A Perfect Balance of Elegance and Warmth

Settlers Country Manor has a rare ability to feel both grand and intimate at once.

The heritage architecture and chandelier-lit Banquet Hall bring a sense of occasion, while the gardens, lake, and century-old trees keep the setting soft and romantic. Whether a couple is planning a formal black-tie celebration or a relaxed garden wedding, the venue adapts beautifully to suit their style.

Planning Your Wedding at Settlers Country Manor

If you're looking for a Settlers Country Manor wedding photographer, I'd love to hear about your plans.

As a preferred vendor at this venue, I know it well, and I'm always excited to be back among the lake, the gardens, and that beautiful old manor light. It's a property that consistently delivers images that feel elegant, romantic, and true to the couple.
